issue.title: Agent sudo requests with terminal-handoff authentication
issue.description: An agent on any machine can request that Bryan authenticate an exact, reviewed batch of sudo commands; authentication happens only on a real TTY handed to sudo/PAM (never through SASE), execution flows through an unprivileged hash-verified runner locally or over ssh -t remotely, a follow-up agent receives a structured ledger, and athena's NOPASSWD sudo policy is tightened so the reviewed approval becomes a real privilege boundary.

issue.title: Sudo manifest contracts and the TTY-attached runner in sase-core
issue.description: core-runner: add the sudo manifest/ledger/risk-badge wire contracts to sase_core and an unprivileged sase_sudo_runner binary (sudo -v, per-command sudo -n, sudo -k on the controlling TTY) shipped as a wheel console script.

issue.title: Typed sudo gate kind with the sase sudo front doors
issue.description: sudo-gate: register the sudo gate kind, add the sase sudo request/answer/list/show CLI group with a questions-style single-turn handoff, requires_tty option enforcement, risk badges, the batch ledger follow-up prompt, and the agent_sudo_requests beta flag.

issue.title: Ratchet the core pin and dependency floor past the runner surface
issue.description: core-pin: ratchet sase-core-revision.txt and the sase-core-rs floor to the release carrying the sudo runner and bindings, keeping binding validators green.

issue.title: ACE review modal and the Authenticate terminal handoff
issue.description: ace-review: add the 🔐 sudo review modal, the synchronous Approve-and-run suspend flow that hands the terminal to the runner, SUDO/SUDOED statuses, single-active-handoff locking, and completion toasts.

issue.title: The /sase_sudo generated skill and the raw-sudo PreToolUse guard
issue.description: skill-guard: author the generated /sase_sudo skill teaching the request contract, add the chezmoi-managed PreToolUse deny for raw sudo in agent Bash calls, and revise the 'SASE never uses sudo' user-facing copy.

issue.title: Machine-targeted and remote-raised sudo over ssh -t
issue.description: remote-sudo: add ssh targets to machine records, machine-targeted requests executed over ssh -t with a sealed manifest, remote-raised requests answered via the ssh -t relay from local ACE, and deny-only behavior on every non-TTY surface.

issue.title: Chezmoi sudo guards and the athena policy tightening
issue.description: athena-policy: guard the chezmoi run_onchange scripts against password-required sudo, then live-tighten athena by replacing the NOPASSWD:ALL sudoers rule and setting ptrace_scope=1 through the shipped /sase_sudo flow itself.

issue.title: Canary absence proof, live remote proof, and flag removal
issue.description: acceptance: land the canary-credential absence suite, run the live apollo machine-targeted proof with a real password prompt, remove the agent_sudo_requests flag, and finish docs and polish.

payload.entry: Implemented the feature-flagged typed sudo gate and sase sudo front doors; verified with focused pytest, just _lint-symvision, just check (scoped escalated to full suite), and sase bead epic-symbols sase-110.2.

Implemented sudo manifest/ledger/risk-badge wire contracts, sase_sudo_runner, PyO3 bindings and wheel console script, mobile/fleet requires_tty deny-only remote approval, contract snapshots, docs, and CI/release smoke updates. Verified with focused sudo/mobile/fleet/gateway/PyO3 tests, PYO3_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 ./scripts/check.sh, and an isolated abi3 wheel install smoke running sase_sudo_runner --help.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Publish and ratchet sudo core binding floor — once the release carrying core commit ab68522 is on PyPI, bump the sase-core-rs floor and flip src/sase/sudo/core.py from the Python fallback seam to the real sudo_manifest_sha256/sudo_derive_risk_badges bindings with validator coverage.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Resolve existing disk-pressure binding skew — committed src/sase/core/disk_pressure.py requires classify_disk_pressure and disk_pressure_wire_schema_version, but current sase-core HEAD ab68522 does not export them, so tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings is red independent of the sudo pin ratchet.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Deploy generated /sase_sudo provider SKILL.md files from the landed SASE revision with sase skill init --force, then apply/update chezmoi - preview in this phase showed all seven provider targets missing, and generated-skills policy keeps deployment out of dirty unlanded source.

Implemented /sase_sudo generated skill source, reviewed-sudo wording updates, and Claude raw-sudo PreToolUse guard in chezmoi; verified with primary just fmt, targeted pytest for skill/copy tests, sase skill init --diff -p claude preview, primary just check passing with full-suite escalation, chezmoi just fmt, bashunit guard tests, chezmoi just check, and epic-symbols empty.

Ratchet verified: sase-core-revision.txt -> 3566872b4916123fedf100b7c5684c701085655c (sase-core v0.34.28), pyproject/uv.lock floor -> sase-core-rs>=0.34.28,<0.35.0; .venv installed 0.34.28 with sudo_runner_main and classify_disk_pressure bindings; validate_sase_core_rs_version --published-minimum, check_sase_core_rs_bindings, validate_sase_core_rs, git diff --check, and final just check passed; sase bead epic-symbols sase-110.3 reported no entries.

Implemented ACE sudo review modal, terminal auth handoff, subset-bound receipts, single-active auth lease, typed sudo status labels, generic-gate password warning, CLI completion refresh, and focused/visual coverage.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Sudo runner bootstrap preflight — teach the agent_sudo_requests flow or runbook to detect hosts whose current sudoers lacks CWD=* before attempting sudo -D, because athena needed a temporary CWD NOPASSWD drop-in to let the runner execute its first reviewed command.

payload.close_reason: The agent completed its work but was unable to finish running the verification command.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Sudo visudo check allowance — the v1 sudo manifest validator rejects visudo entirely, so athena-policy could not run the plan-requested noninteractive `visudo -cf` syntax proof through /sase_sudo; allow a narrow noninteractive validation form or update the runbook to name the accepted root-side evidence.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: athena's sudo tightening went live before the chezmoi-side guards owned by sase-110.7 landed, so any headless 'chezmoi update -a --force' run by a SASE commit finalizer fails as soon as a weekly/monthly run_onchange content hash rolls. First casualty: agent 0l3.f0 (2026-09-15 ~10:34 EDT) — the WEEK# stamp in home/.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_install_lazygit.tmpl rolled and 'sudo install lazygit -D -t /usr/local/bin/' died with 'sudo: a terminal is required to read the password'; the automatic --resume retry failed identically. run_onchange_install_luarocks.tmpl (monthly stamp; sudo apt-get + sudo make install) is the same failure armed for the next month roll.

COORDINATION: at Bryan's request the chezmoi-side guard half of sase-110.7 is being implemented via a separate tale plan, chezmoi_headless_sudo_guards (proposed 2026-09-15). Design: lazygit + luarocks installs go sudo-free into ~/.local (athena PATH puts ~/.local/bin ahead of /usr/local/bin, matching the nvim script convention); the only genuinely-root step left (apt-get lua5.1 bootstrap on fresh machines) is guarded by a new chez::can_sudo helper in lib/chezmoi_utils.sh; and install-script failures soft-fail (loud warning + exit 0) in non-interactive runs so a headless apply can never be blocked, while interactive runs still fail loudly. Once that lands, sase-110.7's remaining scope is the athena policy half only; the stale /usr/local/bin/{lazygit,luarocks} copies stay harmlessly shadowed and can be removed later through a reviewed /sase_sudo request. Also note sase-110.7's worker is currently stopped (its sudo gate shell timed out on 2026-09-15) while the bead is still in_progress — 'sase bead work sase-110' would recover/reassign the non-closed beads when ready.

DISCOVERED ISSUE from proposing bead sase-xe.16.11.7.16.5.4: just check's governed full-suite lane failed once at tests/test_sudo_acceptance.py::test_sudo_local_flow_never_persists_canary_credentials, then the immediate isolated rerun passed on the unchanged tree. No existing flake task matched. Routed here instead of creating a task because active phase sase-110.8 explicitly owns the canary-credential absence suite and commit 67cce7d82a introduced this test while the sudo epic remains in progress; its landing audit should assess/stabilize the intermittent failure.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (from PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on sase-11r.2 note #1, triaged by the sase-11r land agent, 2026-09-16): tests/test_sudo_acceptance.py::test_sudo_local_flow_never_persists_canary_credentials, added by 67cce7d82a as part of this epic's canary-absence suite (phase sase-110.8), can false-positive. _sensitive_tokens() includes 'credential length' = str(len(_CANARY)).encode() = b'8119', and _assert_sensitive_tokens_absent does a raw substring check of that 4-digit token against every file under gate_home and SASE_HOME. Any unrelated timestamp, epoch float, pid or size containing '8119' (sase-11r.2 saw it in pending-action timestamps) fails the test. sase-11r.2's direct rerun passed, and sase-xe.16.11.7.16.5.4 independently recorded one full-suite failure of this node followed by a passing isolated rerun. Fix it inside sase-110.8's suite: drop the bare length token or bound it (for example a delimited JSON field like '"length": 8119'), or pick a canary length whose decimal form cannot occur in timestamps. No separate task was filed because the defect is in this active epic's own acceptance test.
